Name: Girl Mod for Stardew 1.5.1
Author: KonaKona7
Description:
When Stardew 1.4 came out in Nov 2019, I had actually updated these mods for my own personal use from 1.3 to 1.4 because I did not want to wait for the mod creators to update them. With the release of Stardew 1.5 in Dec 2020, it's been 2-3 years since some of these mods were updated. As many people are stuck on 1.3 or forced to abandon their female villagers, I'm releasing my personal updates for these mods.

I did not create these mods, I only created and added new sprites for the new content in 1.4 and 1.5.

[size=4][b]Mod changes:
[/b][/size]Alex -> Alexis
Elliot -> Ellie
Harvey -> Harmony
Sam -> Samantha
Sebastian -> Sabrina
Shane -> Shauna
Gus -> Wendy
Wizard -> Female wizard

Yes, I realize there seems to be a bit of an abundance of green colored swimwear. As much as I wanted to recolor them, I also wanted to keep the color scheme similar to the original male sprites, so there you have it. Green is just a popular color in SDV apparently.

Also included:
Sebastian's bike -> DeLorean
Not technically a male character but these sprites are part of Cursors.xnb which is needed for converting Shane and Sebastian and I unfortunately
don't know Stardew's scripting to provide a patch to Cursors.xnb for only the Girl Mod content. Some of you may view this as a bonus anyway.

Unfortunately, I know little of modding besides sprite editing, so there are no dialogue name changes in this mod, only label names, sprites, and portraits are changed. If someone wants to take all my sprite edits and mod the dialogue, restore Sabrina's bike, create a CP pack of this mod, or whatever else you can think of, please feel free to do with the content as you like.


[b][size=4]Installation:[/size][/b]
Straight XNB mod. Drag and drop Content folder into your Stardew Valley folder and replace existing files to install.
[left]
Final Notes: No, I never did get around to learning how to write scripts to be able to make CP mods, so you'll have to settle for plain XNB mods for now.[/left][size=4][b]
